{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient_id
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq, then drop duplicates on patient_id
df_dedup = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Now filter for control arm and moderate severity
control_moderate_dedup = df_dedup[(df_dedup['arm'] == 'control') & (df_dedup['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check result
print(f"Number of control-arm, moderate-severity patients after deduplication: {len(control_moderate_dedup)}")
print(f"Number of responded=1 in this group: {control_moderate_dedup['responded'].sum()}")
print(f"Response fraction: {control_moderate_dedup['responded'].mean():.4f}")

# Confirm the response variable is binary
print(f"Unique values in 'responded' after filtering: {control_moderate_dedup['responded'].unique()}")

# Return the fraction
control_moderate_dedup['responded'].mean()"}
